result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane arterial road that lacks marked crossings or traffic calming measures. Pedestrian safety is severely compromised by a missing sidewalk on one side and significant vehicle obstructions on the existing walkway on the other.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles from the adjacent commercial lot are parked across the sidewalk, completely blocking the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the commercial frontage.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway lacks any pedestrian refuge or marked crossing points for a long stretch.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, spanning the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk on unpaved surfaces or in the roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to provide space for protected pedestrian and bicycle infrastructure while slowing traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Clearance
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side and enforce parking regulations to keep the right-side sidewalk clear of vehicles.

result.summary: The environment is a car-centric commercial area dominated by a large car dealership lot with no visible pedestrian infrastructure. There is a complete absence of sidewalks, crosswalks, or any form of separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no dedicated walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to share space with vehicles in the lot or roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground across the entire width

hazards.name: Wide Open Pavement
hazards.description: The lack of defined curbs or access management allows vehicles to move unpredictably across the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Densely parked cars and dealership banners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk along the street frontage to provide safe pedestrian passage.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install curbing to physically separate the roadway from the car lot and define vehicle access points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and the lot, while improving the visual environment.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway that lacks lane markings and designated crossing points, creating a high-speed and unpredictable traffic environment. While a sidewalk exists on the left, it is narrow and obstructed by utility poles, and there is no sidewalk provided on the right side of the street.

hazards.name: Wide, unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide road encourages high speeds and unpredictable vehicle movements.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signals visible, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians into the grass or the roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes and add lane markings to slow traffic and provide space for other modes.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crossings with appropriate signage and lighting to improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed, multi-lane arterial road that is highly hostile to pedestrians due to a complete lack of dedicated infrastructure. There are no visible sidewalks, marked crossings, or pedestrian refuge areas, forcing any person on foot to navigate unpaved grass or the roadway itself.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Walkways
hazards.description: There are no paved sidewalks on either side of the road, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto uneven grassy surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and far side of the roadway

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration creates a long, unprotected exposure time for any pedestrian attempting to cross.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes without traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing the severity of potential collisions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide basic pedestrian safety and accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median refuge to break up the crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility paint and advance warning signage.
